final_verdict.summary: Approved. The uncommitted product diff is only tools/runtime_session.py and tools/test_runtime_session.py, plus the receipt at .agent/evidence/130/implementation1/summary.json. All twelve feature 130 acceptance commands are implemented, and that receipt records exit 0 for each. An independent re-run of PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/test_runtime_session.py --check asdf-failure-control also exited 0. Hermetic acceptance uses git archive of committed source, fresh sbcl --no-sysinit --no-userinit --non-interactive, private HOME/XDG, a newly created empty private ASDF output directory, explicit :ignore-inherited-configuration configs, and captured toolchain, lock, and clean-core provenance. The ASDF no-op and genuine failure controls are distinct. Unsaved definitions, an inherited fasl or shared cache, and a deleted definition that survives only in a development image fail. Section 9 Lisp forms are not the launcher. A fresh process is not treated as a fresh build, and empty environment variables are not treated as sufficient. No unsourced NIP-0003 case-to-scenario map was added, and the implementation does not claim full-live, the seventeen-row matrix, or the thirteen-case matrix. Installed .nizam/, public schemas, the public API, and the 7350/9555 figures were not edited. The only feature 129 behavior edit shortens two bounded-printing temporary-directory prefixes, from rendered-overflow- to ro- and from overflow-positive- to op-, so the nested control socket fits in sockaddr_un. That edit does not change the seven feature 129 command texts and does not weaken a feature 129 assertion. Feature 130 is not marked complete.
